# Synthetic fees — test fixture only

## Fee Structure

**Approximate Annual Fee Structure (2099-00):**

- Pre-Nursery: ~₹9,900/year
- Nursery – UKG: ~₹10,900/year
- Class 1-2: ~₹12,900/year
- Class 3-5: ~₹14,900/year
- Class 6-8: ~₹16,900/year
- Class 9-10: ~₹19,900/year
- Class 11-12: ~₹29,900/year

Admission and registration fees are included in this synthetic annual fee example.

**Monthly fee** generally ranges from ₹900/month to ₹2,900/month.

_Note: Fees are approximate and may vary. Contact the school for the latest details._

## Payment Methods

Fees can be paid through **Online** bank transfer / NEFT / UPI, cheque or cash.
All fees must be deposited by the 10th of every month.

## Scholarship

A scholarship programme is available. Contact the school for scholarship details.

## Fee Discount

A fee discount is available for annual tuition payment.

## Transport Fees

Transport fees vary by route. Contact the school for transport details.
